q: The FIFA World Cup 2026 is jointly hosted by:
explanation: The 2026 World Cup (48 teams) is hosted by the United States, Canada and Mexico.
why: Awarded 2030 (with centenary matches in South America).

q: The 2028 Summer Olympic Games will be held in:
explanation: Los Angeles hosts 2028; Brisbane 2032. Paris hosted 2024.

q: The 2026 Winter Olympic Games were held in:
explanation: Milan–Cortina d’Ampezzo hosted the 2026 Winter Olympics in February 2026.

q: COP30, the UN climate conference of November 2025, was held in:
explanation: COP30 was hosted at Belém in the Amazon region of Brazil.

q: Which team won the ICC Champions Trophy 2025 (hosted by Pakistan)?
explanation: India beat New Zealand in the final in Dubai (March 2025). Pakistan was the official host.

q: The Pope elected in May 2025, the first from the United States, took the name:
explanation: Cardinal Robert Francis Prevost was elected Pope Leo XIV on 8 May 2025.

q: Who became President of the United States in January 2025?
explanation: Donald Trump was inaugurated as the 47th President on 20 January 2025.

q: Who has been Prime Minister of Pakistan since March 2024?
explanation: Shehbaz Sharif was elected PM by the National Assembly in March 2024 for his second term.

q: Who has been President of Pakistan since March 2024?
explanation: Asif Ali Zardari was elected President for a second term in March 2024.

q: Pakistan’s military response against India in May 2025 was officially named:
In May 2025, General Syed Asim Munir was promoted to the rank of:
explanation: He became the second Field Marshal in Pakistan’s history after Ayub Khan.

q: Pakistan is serving as a non-permanent member of the UN Security Council for the term:
explanation: Elected in June 2024 for 2025–2026 (its eighth term).

q: Pakistan and Saudi Arabia signed a Strategic Mutual Defence Agreement in:
explanation: Signed in Riyadh in September 2025; an attack on either is treated as an attack on both.

q: In April 2025 India announced that it was holding which agreement "in abeyance"?
explanation: After the Pahalgam attack, India said it would hold the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty in abeyance; Pakistan said any attempt to stop its water would be treated as an act of war. The treaty has no provision for unilateral suspension.
why: Pakistan said it could hold this in abeyance in response.

q: Pakistan’s 27th Constitutional Amendment (November 2025) created a new:
explanation: It established a Federal Constitutional Court to hear constitutional matters and also created the post of Chief of Defence Forces.

q: The UN Secretary-General whose second term runs until the end of 2026 is:
explanation: António Guterres (Portugal) has served since January 2017; his term ends on 31 December 2026, and a successor is chosen during 2026.
